R-26-19
RESOLUTION FOR ADOPTION OF THE 2024 INTERNATIONAL CODE SERIES TO INCLUDE THE
BUILDING, RESIDENTIAL, PLUMBING, MECHANICAL, ENERGY CONSERVATION, FUEL GAS,
EXISTING BUILDING, FIRE, AND SWIMMING POOL AND SPA
CODES, AND FOR THE ADOPTION OF THE 2025 COLORADO WILDFIRE RESILIENCY CODE
EFFECTIVE IN THE UNINCORPORATED AREA OF CLEAR CREEK COUNTY
WHEREAS, C.R.S. §§ 30-28-201 and 204 authorize boards of county commissioners to
adopt and amend a county building code after public hearing; and
WHEREAS, the Board of County Commissioners adopted a building code for all of Clear
Creek County, in 1964; the building code has been updated from time-to-time, most recently by
the adoption of Resolution R-24-82 on December 17, 2024, adopting the 2021 International Code
Series; and
WHEREAS, the 2021 Codes have since been updated in the 2024 International Building,
Residential, Plumbing, Mechanical, Energy Conservation, Fuel Gas, Existing Building, and
Swimming Pool and Spa Code, and 2025 Colorado Wildfire Resiliency Code which will be referred
to as the 2024 International Code Series; and
WHEREAS, the County Building Official has recommended the adoption of the 2024
International Code Series, with the additional modifications for local conditions set forth herein;
and
WHEREAS, the Board of County Commissioners has given notice by at least one
publication in a newspaper of general circulation in the County at least fourteen days prior to
the hearing, stating the time and place of the hearing at which the proposed codes could be
Inspected; and
WHEREAS, the Board of County Commissioners, following a public hearing on March 17,
2026, finds that the proposed code adoption will promote the public health, safety and welfare,
and should be adopted.
NOW THEREFORE BE IT RESOLVED, that the Clear Creek County Board of County
Commissioners hereby adopts the 2024 International Code Series, attached hereto, for the
purpose of regulating the future construction or alteration of dwellings, buildings and structures
within the unincorporated areas of Clear Creek County with the deletions and additions as noted
herein.
